detail: type "standard_user" — First step is to log in. I need to enter the username "standard_user" in the username field.
type "[REDACTED:password]" — Now I need to enter the password "[REDACTED:password]" in the password field to complete the login credentials.
click — Both username and password are filled in. Now I need to click the Login button to proceed.

click — I'm now logged in and on the inventory page. I need to add the Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart. The first "Add to cart" button (e6) corresponds to the Sauce Labs Backpack item which is the first product shown.

click — The Sauce Labs Backpack has been successfully added to the cart - I can see the cart now shows "Cart, 1 items" and the Add to cart button changed to Remove. Now I need to proceed to checkout by clicking on the cart button.
click — I'm now on the cart page which shows the Sauce Labs Backpack with a price of $29.99. I need to proceed to checkout by clicking the Checkout button.
type "Ada" — I'm now on the checkout information page. I need to fill in the shipping information starting with the first name field. I'll enter "Ada" as specified in the example values.
type "Lovelace" — First name "Ada" has been entered successfully. Now I need to fill in the last name field with "Lovelace".
type "94107" — Last name "Lovelace" has been entered successfully. Now I need to fill in the postal code field with "94107".

click — All shipping information has been filled in successfully: First Name "Ada", Last Name "Lovelace", and Postal Code "94107". Now I need to click the Continue button to proceed to the checkout overview page.

finish — Successfully completed the checkout flow. Logged in with standard_user, added Sauce Labs Backpack to cart, proceeded to checkout, filled in shipping information (Ada Lovelace, 94107), and reached the checkout overview page. The page shows:
- Item: Sauce Labs Backpack (Quantity: 1)
- Item total: $29.99
- Tax: $2.40
- Order Total: $32.39
- Payment: SauceCard #31337
- Shipping: Free Pony Express Delivery
